# Data Dictionary – 2023 Children's Health Survey (Analysis Dataset)

This data dictionary describes the variables in the **analysis dataset** after processing, including both raw variables from the survey and derived variables used in analysis.

---

## Outcome

| Variable | Type | Description | Values / Notes |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| `DIABETES` | Binary | Raw variable indicating ever diagnosed with type 2 diabetes | 1 = Yes, 0 = No |
| `DIABETES_CURR` | Binary | Raw variable indicating current diabetes status | 1 = Yes, 0 = No |
| `DIABETES_C` | Binary | Derived variable combining `DIABETES` and `DIABETES_CURR` | 1 = Ever and current diabetes, 0 = Otherwise |
| `diabetes_status` | Factor | Analysis outcome | "No Diabetes", "Diabetes"; derived from `DIABETES_C` |

---

## Demographics

| Variable | Type | Description | Values / Notes |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| `SC_AGE_YEARS` | Numeric | Age of child in years | 6–17 |
| `age_group` | Factor | Age group | "0–5 years", "6–11 years", "12–17 years"; derived from `SC_AGE_YEARS` |
| `SC_SEX` | Categorical | Raw sex variable | 1 = Male, 2 = Female |
| `sex` | Factor | Analysis sex variable | "Male", "Female"; derived from `SC_SEX` |
| `SC_RACE_R` | Categorical | Raw race/ethnicity variable | 1 = White, 2 = Black, 3 = AI/AN, 4 = Asian, 5 = NH/PI, 7 = Multiracial |
| `race` | Factor | Detailed race/ethnicity | "White, non-Hispanic", "Black, non-Hispanic", "AI/AN, non-Hispanic", "Asian, non-Hispanic", "NH/PI, non-Hispanic", "Multiracial, non-Hispanic"; derived from `SC_RACE_R` |
| `race_collapsed` | Factor | Collapsed race categories for analysis | "White, non-Hispanic", "Black, non-Hispanic", "Asian, non-Hispanic", "Other/Multiracial"; derived from `SC_RACE_R` |

---

## Socioeconomic Status

| Variable | Type | Description | Values / Notes |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| `FOODSIT` | Categorical | Raw food insecurity status | 1 = Never, 2+ = Sometimes/Often insecure |
| `food_insecure` | Factor | Binary food insecurity | "Never insecure", "Somewhat/Often insecure"; derived from `FOODSIT` |
| `ACE1` | Numeric | Adverse childhood experiences | 0–10 |
| `econ_hardship` | Factor | Economic hardship based on ACE | "Never/Rarely", "Somewhat/Very often"; derived from `ACE1` |
| `FPL_I1:FPL_I6` | Numeric | Family poverty level indicators | 1–? |
| `FPL_MIN` | Numeric | Minimum family poverty level across indicators | Derived from `FPL_I1:FPL_I6` |
| `fpl_category` | Factor | Poverty category based on `FPL_MIN` | "<100% FPL", "100–199% FPL", "200–399% FPL", "≥400% FPL" |
| `socioeconomic_status` | Factor | Composite economic hardship indicator | "High/Med status", "Lower status"; derived from `FOODSIT`, `ACE1`, `FPL_MIN` |

---

## Physical Activity

| Variable | Type | Description | Values / Notes |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| `PHYSACTIV` | Numeric | Raw variable: days of physical activity per week | 0–7 |
| `physactiv_cat` | Factor | Physical activity categorized | "0 days/week", "1–3 days/week", "4–6 days/week", "7 days/week"; derived from `PHYSACTIV` |
| `physactiv_bin` | Factor | Binary physical activity level | "Low (0–3 days)", "High (4–7 days)"; derived from `PHYSACTIV` |

---

## Notes

- All derived variables are included in the analysis dataset `analysis_df`.  
- Missing values (`NA`) were removed for all key analysis variables: `diabetes_status`, `PHYSACTIV`, `SC_AGE_YEARS`, `SC_SEX`, `SC_RACE_R`, `socioeconomic_status`.  
- Factor variables are labeled for clarity in tables and regression analyses.
